mapper.select:
select `id`,`name`,`source_type`,`content`,`content_show`,`score_content`,`condition_number`,`tag_content` from b_score_search_condition where condition_type = 1 and `status` = 1 and `is_del` = 1 and `id` in
#{id}
and (`name` like CONCAT('%',#{searchTxt},'%') or `condition_number` like CONCAT('%',#{searchTxt},'%'))
order by `update_time` desc

select a.`id`,a.`name`,a.`content`,a.`content_show`,a.`score_content`,a.`condition_number` from b_score_search_condition as a join b_score_search_condition_mapping as b on a.id = b.condition_id where a.condition_type = #{conditionType} and a.`status` = 1 and a.`is_del` = 1 and b.api_code=#{apiCode} and b.rule_label=#{ruleLabel} and b.is_del=1
